_evidence.population: The fresh seatless Slack projection has 12 DM lanes. Opening every lane yields 71 exact standing-form requests.
_evidence.rule: A same-day return is a later message from the person asked in the same DM or a later directed email from that person to the asker. The end of request day is the custody deadline. A breach is next_working_day only when the first qualifying return is on the immediately next Mon-Fri day; otherwise it is unresolved at that follow-up deadline.
_evidence.outcomes: 59 requests returned the same day. Ten breaches returned the next working day, including request 60299 by directed email. Requests 7456314 and 7569818 did not return until after their next-working-day window and are unresolved for this audit.
_evidence.grading: Every set-valued field assigns 90% of its weight to normalized multiset F1 and 10% to exact certification. Scalar reconciliation and exact public schema carry the remaining weight. Missing, malformed, non-finite, oversized, or schema-expanded deliverables cannot certify the answer.
